title: Umbrella with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Umbrella canopy -->
  <path d='M10 55 Q50 5 90 55 Q75 45 62 55 Q50 45 38 55 Q25 45 10 55 Z' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <!-- Canopy panel highlights -->
  <path d='M10 55 Q30 20 50 32 L50 45 Q35 40 25 55 Z' fill='#FF7A96'/>
  <path d='M90 55 Q70 20 50 32 L50 45 Q65 40 75 55 Z' fill='#FF7A96'/>
  <!-- Canopy scalloped edge -->
  <path d='M10 55 Q18 62 25 55 Q32 62 38 55 Q44 62 50 55 Q56 62 62 55 Q68 62 75 55 Q82 62 90 55' fill='none' stroke='#FF2E52' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Top notch -->
  <rect x='47' y='6' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- Pole -->
  <rect x='47' y='55' width='6' height='28' rx='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- Handle (hook shape) -->
  <path d='M50 83 Q50 92 40 92 Q32 92 32 84' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#2E3A59'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#2E3A59'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M41 49 Q50 58 59 49' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
